explanation.headline: Not on FDA's shortage list, and no FDA signal at our plants

sentences.text: FDA's records show nicardipine hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 222 vials at 13.2 per day for 16.9 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 226 vials at 14.4 per day for 15.7 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 86 vials at 3.1 per day for 27.9 days on hand.
The top-ranked option is to buy from Caplin Steriles Limited, whose plant was last inspected NAI on 2024-08-09.
Alternative manufacturers include Cipla USA Inc. with plants last inspected VAI on 2023-01-27 and 2024-07-25, and Qilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. with a plant last inspected VAI on 2023-05-19.
